name: Handmade Product Business System in Excel – Profit per Batch
html:
See which products really make money after materials, labour, fees and shipping, which batches are ready to sell and which supplier order is late – before you set the next price or pour the next batch. This is a complete back office for a small handmade studio in Excel: eight connected workbooks that already work with sample data, so you see every alert and dashboard before you type your first product.

Built for owner-makers with a few makers and a packer, making candles, soaps, bath and body products and selling through their own online shop, online marketplaces, craft fairs, wholesale to gift shops and custom or corporate gift orders.

What you get:

  • 8 connected workbooks: formulas, costing and pricing; batch production, cure and quality; materials, stock and purchasing; online orders, shipping and returns; fairs, markets and custom orders; wholesale shops and invoices; range, reviews and growth; profit, cash and tax
  • 552 ready pages: dashboards, calculators, printable forms and checklists, and ready WhatsApp messages
  • 15 languages, each as a blank template, with filled sample-data copies in English
  • Standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice – no macros, no subscription

How it works: 1) open the workbook in your language, 2) type your formulas, batches, stock, orders and sales in the yellow cells, 3) costs, margins, reorder alerts, cure dates and profit per product and channel update by themselves. One payment, instant download.

What it does for you

  • Know the true cost per unit from wax, oils, fragrance, containers, labour and overhead
  • Set prices that keep your margin on every channel after fees and shipping
  • Catch a batch that used too much material before it eats the profit
  • See every batch with its number, cure date and yield, and what is ready to sell
  • Spot an overloaded maker before the day happens, not after
  • Never run out of a material and order again at the right reorder point
  • Trace any lot to every batch it went into if a delivery goes wrong
  • Ship and pack on time and see the profit of every online order
  • Know before you book whether a craft fair will pay after stall fee and helper
  • Quote custom and corporate gift orders with deposits, proofs and delivery dates
  • Send line sheets and invoices to shops and chase late payers on time
  • See profit by product and channel, and cash eight weeks ahead with tax set aside

Do I need special software?
No. The files are standard xlsx files for Microsoft Excel and LibreOffice, which is free.

Does it fit a one-person studio and a bigger team?
Yes. It works for an owner-maker working alone and for a studio with several makers; the sample data shows an owner-maker, three makers, a packer and two assistants, 24 products, 34 materials, five sales channels, about 2,650 online orders and eight wholesale shops.

Can I replace the sample data with my own?
Yes. Every workbook comes in 15 languages as a blank template, plus filled sample-data copies in English, so you can explore first and start clean when you are ready. Each fact is typed once and every dashboard reads it from there.

Can I use my own currency, rates and targets?
Yes. Currency, labour rate, target and minimum margin, channel fees, free shipping amount, reorder cover days, payment grace days and tax set-aside are on the settings and list sheets, and every formula follows your changes.

Where do I start?
Start with Part 1 to cost your products and set prices, or with the part that hurts most today, such as stock or late invoices. Each workbook works alone and links to the others as you fill it.

Are there macros or a subscription, and how do I receive it?
No macros and no subscription. You pay once and download a ZIP at once with every workbook in all 15 languages.
seo: Run your candle, soap and body-care studio from 8 connected Excel workbooks: costing, batches, stock, orders, fairs
